rules.name: Troops where the Protector stands
rules.text: Each build: in each country where the Protector has a node, 1 adversary troop lands.

rules.name: Warmongering
rules.text: Each production step, a military base with an adversary troop on or next to it makes 1 extra corp troop, even past its cap; at most 1 extra a base each production step, whatever makes it.

difficulty.text: Militarist, harder: every event that lands troops lands 1 more in each country.

events.name: Probing Strikes
events.text: Each country: a Military 1 threat. The adversary gains 2 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Arrivals: coastal cities.

events.name: Factory Drive
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Economic 1. The adversary gains 2 compute. 1 troop lands on each country's first base. Factories next to clean cities gain 1 adversary ambassador. Arrivals: industrial zones.

events.name: Long Patrols
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Cyber 1. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each country's clean city with the most adversary ambassadors gains 1 more. Spread reaches 1 hex further. Arrivals: research stations.

events.name: War Drums
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Influence 1. The adversary gains 2 compute. 1 troop lands on each country's first base. Sway 1 toward Discord. Arrivals: each country's first base.

events.name: Signal Jamming
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Grid 1. The adversary gains 2 compute. Each country's clean city with the most adversary ambassadors gains 1 more. Every botnet makes 1 adversary ambassador on its hex. Arrivals: coastal cities.

events.name: Mobilization
events.text: Each country: a Military 2 threat. The adversary gains 3 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each corrupted city gains 1 more adversary ambassador. Arrivals: coastal cities. Escalation.

events.name: Station Raids
events.text: Each country: Military 2 or Cyber 2. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each corrupted research station gains 1 adversary ambassador. Arrivals: research stations. Escalation.

events.name: Fifth Column
events.text: Each country: Influence 2 or Cyber 2. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each country's clean city with the most adversary ambassadors gains 1 more. Cities corrupt at 1 fewer adversary ambassador. Arrivals: coastal cities. Escalation.

events.name: Border War
events.text: Each country: a Military 2 threat. The adversary gains 2 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each player destroys 1 of their nodes. Arrivals: each country's first base. Escalation.

events.name: Supply Lines
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Economic 1. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Factories next to clean cities gain 1 adversary ambassador. Arrivals: industrial zones. Escalation.

events.name: Forced March
events.text: Each country: any tier-2 threat. The adversary gains 3 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Every adversary troop takes 1 more step this round. Arrivals: industrial zones. Escalation.

events.name: Total Mobilization
events.text: Each country: a Military 3 threat, and Economic 2 or Grid 2. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 2 troops land on factories (else cities). Each corrupted city gains 1 more adversary ambassador. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Arrivals: industrial zones.

events.name: Blitzkrieg
events.text: Each country: any tier-3 threat, and Military 1 or Influence 1. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 2 troops land on factories (else cities). Sway 1 toward Discord. Spread reaches 1 hex further. Arrivals: each country's first base.

events.name: Occupation
events.text: Each country: Military 3 or Cyber 3, and an Influence 2 threat. The adversary gains 5 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each country's clean city with the most adversary ambassadors gains 1 more. Cities corrupt at 1 fewer adversary ambassador. Arrivals: research stations.

events.name: Naval Blockade
events.text: Each country: Economic 3 or Grid 3, and Military 1 or Cyber 1. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 2 troops land on factories (else cities). Factories next to clean cities gain 1 adversary ambassador. Arrivals: coastal cities.
